- the guests initially paid $30 total ($10 each).
- the manager refunds $5, so the actual cost of the room is $25.
- the bellboy keeps $2 and returns $1 to each guest, meaning each guest effectively paid $9 ($10 - $1), totaling $27.
- of this $27, $25 goes to the hotel, and $2 is with the bellboy.
